body: Nisar Ahmed Bhanbhro, J: By this single order, I intend to dispose of compromise applications under sections 345(2) and 345(6) of the Criminal Procedure Code filed in the captioned Criminal Revision Applications; out of which Criminal Revision Application was filed by applicant Karimdad against impugned judgment dated 23-12-2025 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge, Khipro, in Criminal Appeal No. 02 of 2025 Re: Khamiso and others v. The State (arising out of F.I.R bearing Crime No. 204/ 2025 for offence under sections 324, 114, 337-A(i),F(i),F(iii),337-L(ii),504, 34 PPC of P.S Khipro), whereby the conviction awarded to the applicant vide judgment dated 28-08-2025 by learned Assistant Sessions Judge, Khipro, in Sessions Case No.53/ 2025 Re: The State v. Khamiso and others was maintained. Whereas Criminal Revision Application No. 07/ 2026 was filed by applicant Rano against order dated 29-11-2025 whereby due to his absence the Criminal Appeal No. 02/ 2025 was dismissed to his extent. The applicants/ accused were convicted and sentenced as under: U/S 324 PPC Accused Rano Dars was sentenced to three years rigorous imprisonment and to pay fine of Rs.20,000 (Twenty thousand) and in case of failure of payment of fine, he shall further suffer to undergo S.I for three months more.
Accused Rano Dars was sentenced to pay Daman Rs.30,000/- to injured Khan Muhammad and in case of failure of payment of Daman, he shall suffer S.I for two months.
Accused Rano was sentenced to pay Daman Rs.30,000/- to injured Khan Muhammad and in case of failure of payment of Daman he shall suffer S.I for two months.
Accused Karimdad was sentenced to pay Daman Rs.10,000/- to injured Khan Muhammad and in case of failure of payment of Daman he shall suffer S.I for two months.
Accused Khan Muhammad was sentenced to pay Daman Rs.10,000/- to Mitho and in case of failure of payment of Daman he shall suffer S.I for two months.
Accused Khamiso Dars was convicted and sentenced to three years rigorous imprisonment.

Accused Rano, Karimdad, Khan Muhammad and Khamiso were convicted and sentenced to one year simple imprisonment and to pay fine of Rs.2,000 (Two thousand) each and in case of failure of payment of fine, he shall further suffer to undergo S.I for one month more.

2. During pendency of instant Criminal Revision Applications, the parties have patched up outside the Court and filed compromise applications. Complainant Muhammad Usman and injured persons namely Mithu and Khan Muhammad filed their affidavits in support of compromise applications, wherein they have categorically stated that due to intervention of nek mards, they have patched up with the applicants outside the court and have pardoned the applicants in the name of Almighty Allah and have no objection if the applicants are acquitted from the charge of instant case. The complainant and above named both injured, present in court, have re-affirmed the contents of their affidavits.
3. Learned D.P.G frankly recorded his no objection for allowing the compromise applications as all sections applied in this case are compoundable.

4. Since all sections applied in this case are compoundable and the compromise arrived at between the parties on the very face of it appears to be genuine, without any undue inducement or pressure, hence application u/s 345(2) Cr.P.C is allowed, as such, the impugned judgment dated 23-12-2025 and Order dated 29-11-2025 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge, Khipro, in Criminal Appeal No. 02 of 2025 Re: Khamiso and others v. The State (arising out of F.I.R bearing Crime No. 204/ 2025 for offence under sections 324, 114, 337- A(i),F(i),F(iii),337-L(ii),504, 34 PPC of P.S Khipro) and the judgment dated 28-08- 2025 passed by learned Assistant Sessions Judge, Khipro, in Sessions Case No.53/ 2025 Re: The State v. Khamiso and others are set aside. Consequently, applicants namely Karimdad s/o Sohdo and Rano s/o Macharo are hereby acquitted under Section 345(6) Cr.P.C in above case/crime. The applicants are present on bail; their bail bonds are cancelled and surety stands discharged.
5. In the above terms, instant Criminal Revision Applications stand disposed of.
Signed copy of this Order be kept in connected Criminal Revision Application No.S-07 of 2026.
